subject: Rescheduling tomorrow's call
text:
Hi everyone,

I'm sorry to send this last minute, but I need to move tomorrow's call. My train was cancelled after a signal failure, and I won't get to town until much later than planned. Rather than have people sit waiting, let's push the meeting back two days. Would Thursday at the same time work better? If so, I'll send the updated invite and a shorter agenda so we can still cover the key items quickly.

If Thursday is difficult for some folks, please reply with one time that suits you. I'm fine with earlier, later, or Saturday morning if that helps. For now, please do not prepare anything extra. The volunteer roster, donation follow-up list, and any questions from last week are enough. I'll keep the call focused and try not to overrun.

One small practical note: please bring the updated sign-up sheet even if it is still rough. We can tidy it together during the call rather than making it homework. Also, if the disruption affects your connection or commute, join from wherever is safest and quieter; background noise is fine. I would rather keep things simple than insist on formalities while people are juggling sudden schedule changes.

Thanks for your flexibility. I know changing plans is annoying, and I appreciate everyone adjusting. I'll confirm the final time once I hear back. If anything urgent comes up before then, message me rather than email.

Best,
